questions.question: Which one of the following is the largest recognised constellation?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Hydra is the largest constellation**__.
 
• It measures __**1303 square degrees and it is also the longest at over 100 degrees.**__
 
• **Centaurus** is the brightest constellation.
 
• **Crux**, also known as the Southern Cross is the smallest constellation.
 
• Canis Major constellation contains the **brightest star Sirius**.
 
• Constellation is a group of stars that form a particular pattern and are generally named according to the shape it has. There are officially 88 constellations recognized so far.

questions.question: In Parliament, who takes the final decision on whether a Bill is a Money Bill or not?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Lok Sabha Speaker certifies the bill as a money bill before sending it to the upper house, and the decision of the **Speaker is binding on both the Houses.**__He/she represents the full authority of the House and decides whether a bill is a money bill or not.
 
• A money bill or supply bill is a bill that solely concerns taxation or government spending.
 
• The Speaker appoints the Secretary-General of the Lok Sabha.
 
• The Lok Sabha speaker is the presiding officer of the Lok Sabha.
 
• The Speaker ranks sixth in the hierarchy of State government of India, equivalent with the Chief Justice.

questions.question: What is the other name for 'Orion' Constellation?
questions.solution:
__
 
• Orion constellation is one of the brightest and best known constellations in the night sky. It lies on the celestial equator.
 
• Orion has been known since ancient times. **The constellation is also known as the Hunter, as it is associated with one in Greek mythology.**__
 
• It represents the mythical hunter Orion, who is often depicted in star maps as either facing the charge of Taurus, the bull.

questions.question: When was the 'Battle of Tukaroi' fought?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **Battle of Tukaroi**__ was fought between Akbar and the Sultanate of Bengal on __**3 March 1575**__.
 
• The battle was won by the Mughal forces and it resulted in the Mughal annexation of Bengal.
 
• This battle was fought in a village called Tukaroi, located in the present day Balasore District in Odisha.

questions.question: Identify the element that is most prolific in the crust of the earth.
questions.solution:

• **Oxygen**__ is the most abundant element found in the earth crust. Oxygen accounts to 46.6% of the Earth Crust.
 
• O > Si > Al > Fe > Ca are the most abundant element in earth crust.
 
• Aluminium is the most abundant metal in the earth's crust.

questions.question: Which of the following is called the 'Grand Canyon of India'?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The **Gorge of Gandikota**__ is situated on the Pennar River in __**Andhra Pradesh**__ .
 
• __**It is known as the Grand Canyon of India.**__
 
• The Grand Canyon is located in Arizona, USA.
 
• A gorge is a valley formed by a source of water flowing between tall slabs of steep rocks.The Pennar river must have cut rocks in Gandokota over centuries to have formed the Canyon which we see today.

questions.question: What is the unit of measure of a magnetic field?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Tesla is the SI unit of magnetic field.**__
 
• Magnetic field strength is one of two ways that the intensity of a magnetic field can be expressed.
 
• Technically, a distinction is made between magnetic field strength H, measured in amperes per meter (A/m), and magnetic flux density B, measured in Newton - meters per ampere (Nm/A), also called Tesla (T).
 
• 1 Tesla equals to 104 Gauss. The smaller unit being gauss.
